verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own documentation is served in llms.txt and agent-friendly markdown formats (docs.claude.com/llms.txt, .md variants with an explicit documentation index for tools), showing first-party embrace of the llms.txt convention, and the product has general web-fetch/agentic-search and MCP capabilities that could consume such docs. However there is no explicit documented workflow or example of a user pointing Claude Code at an arbitrary llms.txt file for grounding/context. Missing for 10: explicit feature/example of ingesting a third-party llms.txt or agent-oriented doc file as context, and independent confirmation this works in practice.
